context_requirements: The annotated targets EWSR1 and FLI1 are not druggable in a way that produces a transcriptional signature in these lines.
No direct transcriptional program is expected from inhibiting apoptosis per se in the absence of a death stimulus.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent transcriptional signature at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
Consistent upregulation of apoptosis-related landmark genes such as BCL2, BIRC2, CFLAR, or BCL2L1.
A shared signature across multiple lines that is not explained by generic stress or proliferation.

evidence.supports: NF-kappaB directly activates the apoptosis inhibitor Bcl-xL, showing apoptosis inhibitors can be transcriptionally regulated.
API2 (c-IAP2) is an apoptosis inhibitor recurrently rearranged in MALT lymphoma.
IEX-1L is an NF-kappaB-induced apoptosis inhibitor mediating cell survival.

changes: Removed PMID 19509158: abstract concerns miR-21 as an apoptosis inhibitor in tongue squamous cell carcinoma, not a transcriptional response to an apoptosis-inhibitor drug.
Removed PMID 18319255: abstract concerns miR-224 targeting API-5 in hepatocellular carcinoma, not a transcriptional response to an apoptosis-inhibitor drug.
